The real estate agent is selling two homes right now: one that was owned by a Sri Lankan family, and one that was owned by a Somali family. The agents needs to have both houses cleaned, but the Somali family's house needs more cleaning because it smells of food, while the Sri Lankan family home will be a breeze to sell. Which home is easy to sell?
A. The Somali family's home
B. Cannot be determined
C. The Sri Lankan family's home
